🚨 Released early. Back inside in four days.

A new report says a man released from HMP Wandsworth after serving 11 of a 32-week sentence was back in prison four days later, and that approved premises are closing while probation struggles to cope.

Prison overcrowding is real, but opening the doors faster than the system can supervise people isn't the answer. Public safety must come first. 👇
